name: HextrudORT
description: The HextrudORT is an open source direct drive extruder designed by MirageC79 (Olivier) for the HevORT project. It reuses Bondtech BMG internals with a 50:17 gear ratio (approximately 3:1), providing reliable extrusion in a compact, lightweight package. Its hexagonal motor mount layout gives the design its name and allows for a compact toolhead build.
features: Uses Bondtech BMG internals (50:17 gear ratio)
